summary: Phase 8 of 8 only, per the dispatch's single-phase mission -- and it is the LAST phase, so this record is complete. WHAT PHASE 8 LANDED, in five plan-scoped files plus three machine-generated ones. (1) The probe is wired: "seam-gluing-ray-product/hit-presented-model-a" added to scripts/check-evidence-probes.sh's WIRED list with its own table entry stating the decision it holds in place; the guard now compiles 24 probes and ALL PASS, including the unchanged presented-not-complete. The probe sits outside the Lake build graph so lake build never touches it -- the guard is what keeps it from rotting. (2) Two C14 axiom pins for HitPresented and hitPresented_of_presented in Tests/BimodalTest/Metalogic/KTypeSummaryAxiomTest.lean, at profiles OBSERVED rather than predicted: a throwaway two-line file was run through lake env lean under the build guard to read #print axioms BEFORE either pin was authored, and both came back [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] (hitPresented_of_presented's wraps across three lines purely because the name is longer). They land under a note saying why these are the harness's FIRST Presented-family rows that are NOT vacuous on fixture model A: the trace-level hypothesis has no inhabitant there for any finite presentation, the Hit-level one does. (3) Exactly one new docs/theorem-index.md row, anchored at its declaration by the Paper: -- line Phase 1 wrote; C15's second assertion passes over all 261 rows. (4) The RaySummary README's verdict (C) row moved from "satisfiability on model A is OPEN" to "half-settled, and only the easier half", plus a sixth-wired-probe inventory entry, plus the Trace.lean table row's stale line count corrected 371 -> 415. THE VERDICT IS AMENDED, NEVER RETIRED: its own opening claim -- the ray-product presentation as landed cannot deliver Decidable (PlusValidZTime phi) -- is left verbatim, (S) and (W) are still recorded as missing, and Probe735.not_presented stays wired and passing, with the new entry saying in its own text that the two hold side by side on the same fixture, seam and phi. (5) THE BOUND VERDICT, recorded in both the probe header and the README: BLOCKED, with the obstruction specific rather than a shrug. hitCl_eq_truncated's L comes from Set.Finite.bddAbove over HitCl and is never exhibited, so card_QA's L + 6 and jump_window_card's L + 1 are functions of a number nothing produces. The in-tree entry point for an EFFECTIVE bound is kTypeOf_listSeg_append_congr; the threshold consequence is absent, re-derived at this phase by the grep the plan mandated -- Saturation.lean's four theorems are kTypeColouring_eq_of_matching_segments, kEquiv_zFiber_of_matching_segments, kTypeOf_zFiber_eq_of_sameTriple and kTypeOf_zFiber_eq_of_inFamily, and a case-insensitive sweep for threshold/block-length/periodicity returns ZERO matches, so nothing has landed since plan time and the verdict needed no revision. The single missing obligation, kTypeOf_listSeg_replicate_eventually_periodic, is STATED AND NOT PROVED in two places and deliberately NOT landed as a sorry anywhere. ACCEPTANCE BRANCH 3's SUBSTITUTION IS STATED, NOT SMOOTHED OVER: a claim that NO computable bound exists is not a Lean-statable property of this development, so that branch is not literally satisfiable, and both the header and the README say so and name what IS machine-checked instead -- the headline's exists-L shape, which puts the non-exhibition in the STATEMENT rather than in prose, and its Classical.choice foot. That is the cycle-1 approved substitution; nothing anywhere asserts impossibility. FULL GATE SET GREEN, every item the plan named and none hand-picked: full project build guard exit 0, "Build completed successfully (2836 jobs)", zero error: and zero warning: over the captured stream, .olean newer than source for the one module touched (all three tiers of the terminal bar); check-evidence-probes.sh exit 0 with 24/24 PASS; check-module-invariants.sh exit 0 ALL CHECKS PASSED (C14 both assertions, C15 66 anchors + 261 rows, C9/C9D zero task-number citations); verify-deploy.sh exit 0, PASS -- 14 checks, 0 failures, complete set and not under --skip-slow (one pre-existing WARN about the lean manifest's routing_hard, unrelated); sorry census 0 with cross_check MATCH (compiler 0, stripper 0); vacuous count 1, the pre-existing int_domain_universal, unchanged. AXIOM COUNT REPORTED HONESTLY RATHER THAN AS 'UNCHANGED': the crude ^axiom grep went 14 -> 15, but NOT ONE of the 15 matches is an actual axiom declaration -- every one is a prose line that happens to begin with the word 'axiom' at a comment wrap, and the new 15th is this phase's own markdown line in the RaySummary README. A diff of every *.lean file since the pre-dispatch commit shows no +axiom line: zero axioms added. CHALLENGE FIDELITY CLOSED FOR THE WHOLE RECORD, not just the headline: the advisory lean-challenge-snapshot.sh --check gate is UNAVAILABLE here (exit 71, no manifest, never taken at plan time), so a mechanical whitespace-normalized comparison of the plan's Lean Challenge Statements block against the live tree was run instead -- all 24 declared identifiers exist, 19 match byte-for-byte, MA and stepOf match on their full signature prefix with the only difference being that the comparison script swallowed their where/pattern-match bodies, and a, b, pa are def where the block wrote abbrev (identical type and value, already recorded and reasoned in the Phase 2 handoff against presented-not-complete.lean's own defs). No added hypothesis, no specialized quantifier, no weakened conclusion anywhere. PROSE AUDIT over ADDED LINES ONLY, not whole-file counts which carry pre-existing matches: zero added lines match complexity/EXPTIME/2EXP/Buchi/MSO/finite width/finite fibre; zero added lines outside specs/** carry a task-number citation; every added line matching decidab|PlusValid|decision procedure inspected individually -- two are the DecidableEq instance binder in the stated obligation, four are the Decidability.RaySummary namespace path in a #print axioms line, every remaining one is an explicit disclaimer. THREE ISSUES RECORDED AS THEY AROSE, two of them real gate collisions neither of which was bypassed. The first commit was BLOCKED by the pre-commit typst-sync-check.sh Check 2 gate over tests-line-count 22943 vs a live 22982 -- a delta of exactly the 39 lines this phase added to the axiom-test module, so the drift was arithmetically THIS dispatch's own and the gate's own --no-verify escape (reserved for 'another writer's' drift) would have been a misuse of its stated exemption; repaired with typst-sync-check.sh --fix. Then check-module-invariants.sh failed INV on two stale GENERATED inventory blocks in README.md and FormalSystem/Metalogic/README.md; diagnosed rather than assumed foreign -- the Decidability/ figure was off by exactly the 44 lines PHASE 1 added to Trace.lean and never regenerated, and the root README delta was +9 code / +29 comment with the .lean file count unchanged at 670, so this is this record's OWN inherited debt surfacing at its first gate-running phase, repaired with check-module-invariants.sh --emit-inventory. Both were machine-generated repairs, never hand-edits, and each diff was inspected for foreign content. SCOPE HYPOTHESIS: the five-file prediction and the exactly-one-new-index-row prediction both held exactly, but the hypothesis also said a SIXTH touched file means a sibling task's edit must be unstaged -- eight were touched, and that diagnosis rule was simply wrong for this phase, since all three extras are machine-generated artifacts this record's own line additions obliged. THREE DEVIATION ANNOTATIONS on plan items, all additive and none weakening a claim: the presented-not-complete table entry's trailing 'HitPresented left OPEN' line was cross-referenced rather than left asserting as open what the entry beside it settles; the README's Trace.lean row got its stale line count and missing description fixed beyond the three named edits; and the probe header's own 'The decision held in place' paragraph carried a stale forward-reference ('recorded by the later phases rather than here') that this very edit falsified and which was corrected -- the same defect class Phase 7 found, which suggests forward-referencing prose in a multi-phase probe should be audited by whichever phase makes it false. Two checklist items remain unticked in already-COMPLETED phases (Phase 5's commit box, which did happen, and Phase 6's contingency, which never fired); left as found rather than silently ticked on another phase's behalf. Three commits: 8ad8462a7, 68c3828a2 (pins and index row in ONE commit per C14), 6b959c4ea.
